implementation: Readable C99 composition of the verified decimal logarithm and division kernels; no CPU execution, ROM execution or host floating-point arithmetic

implemented_routines.name: public arbitrary-base real logarithm
implemented_routines.scope: Base in operand0 and argument in operand2; decimal/rational/marked records and compact two-surd conversion, F3 domain errors and native fifteen-digit result

implemented_routines.name: arbitrary-base logarithm kernel
implemented_routines.scope: Save argument, compute log10(base) first, compute log10(argument) second, discard both guard words and divide in native order

implemented_routines.name: scalar operation selector10
implemented_routines.scope: Shared wrapper branch to arbitrary-base log kernel and result serialization
